issue.title: Canon in-progress status text fails minimum contrast

zooms.mechanism: Chromium device-metrics equivalent of 200% browser zoom: half CSS viewport with doubled device scale factor

applicableStates.activation: activate the corresponding card media stage, then measure the same status label

notApplicableStates.reason: D02/D05 status labels are non-focusable status text, not controls
D02/D05 status labels have no pointer activation behavior
D02/D05 status labels have no keyboard activation behavior
D02/D05 status labels expose no selected/current state
D02/D05 status labels do not support disabled state

When no overlay intersects, the state is absent; when the unrelated global service-status notice occludes the label at extreme responsive zoom, the label is hidden rather than rendered against a changed contrast background. Geometry and topmost-element evidence are recorded, then the notice is suppressed only in the harness before underlying contrast states are measured.

deterministicConditions.network: loopback and data URLs only; external requests blocked
deterministicConditions.images: all document images complete or explicit load/error resolution required
deterministicConditions.screenshots: temporary element crops only; no baseline writes

measurement.textClassification: normal text unless measured font size/weight establishes large text
measurement.computedPair: computed foreground composited over the effective ancestor background
measurement.renderedSampling: dominant rendered background plus foreground pixels closest to the computed foreground; antialias edge pixels excluded
measurement.nonuniformBackground: record multiple background samples and the lowest reliable foreground/background ratio
measurement.axe: scoped color-contrast rule on each exact element

environmentMatrix.dynamicApplicabilityRule: media-selected becomes NOT_APPLICABLE, with recorded visibility evidence, when the approved responsive composition hides the corresponding media stage; overlay records intersection geometry and remains NOT_APPLICABLE to contrast when an unrelated notice occludes rather than restyles the label

passRules: Every applicable measurement cell has computed ratio >= 4.5:1.
Every applicable non-forced-colors cell has a reliable rendered sample ratio >= 4.5:1.
Scoped axe color-contrast failures are zero.
No unknown state, harness error, or contradictory static/Next evidence exists.
failRules: Any reliable current computed or rendered sample below 4.5:1 is REPRODUCED_CURRENT.
A missing essential browser/environment, unknown measurement, harness error, or contradictory evidence is BLOCKED_INCONCLUSIVE.
reopenCriteria: A current deterministic run reproduces a contrast ratio below 4.5:1 on D02 or D05.
The failing route, runtime, state, viewport, browser/version, zoom, device scale factor, and exact element are captured.
Actual foreground, effective composited background, image/gradient/backdrop interaction, and pixel coordinates are recorded.
The former proposal is revalidated against current source or a new proposal hash is produced.
A new issue-specific owner approval authorizes the exact current proposal before implementation.
rollback: git revert the Phase 5D-1 test/evidence and documentation commits; product source remains untouched
